venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Shotgun. Baugh downhill. Hitch when they sit. Odd front. Name the shell.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Film Desk lock draft 2026-09-09. Charles tape wins. Fan rail stays empty until he says go.
headline: They handed FAU the first look and took it back before the Owls could settle. Then they played their game.
recap: They handed FAU the first look at Ben Hill Griffin and took it back before the Owls could settle. Third-and-10 at the Florida 35, DJ Coleman is already sitting in the window — not a guess, a pick that happens because the front made him hold it. After that Florida played the game they came to play. They spread the field, ran Jaden Baugh until the defense sat down to stop him, and threw it now when it did. Patrick Durkin from 53. An 18-yard FAU punt tees up the next Florida score. They never give it back on fourth down. Florida never punts.

offense.body:
Buster Faulkner does not open a season hunting a trick. He opens it with a count. Spread the field until they cannot load the box and still cover the people who beat you. Live in the shotgun. Give Jaden Baugh 13 the downhill look and make them declare. Sit on the run and the hitch is waiting. Cheat it and they go. Pistol showed once. The sneak is a conversion, not an identity.

The line already looks more technically sound than a year ago, and the run hits with a physicality you feel before you find it on the sheet. That is why Faulkner can keep giving it to Baugh. The front is moving people.

The first Gator run is the whole idea in one snap. Shotgun, Baugh, middle, nine yards from their own 6. They live there. The only official snap that left the gun was fourth-and-1, Aaron Philo 12, plus four. They needed a yard. They took four. Then they went back to being who they are.

Brown III 1 and Wilson 6 are why the box empties. The hitch only lives if those two are out there making somebody choose.

defense.body:
Brad White’s Florida is an odd front, and it looks like one on purpose. Three down. JACK is Jayden Woods. STAR. Graham at WILL. When the broadcast counts four rushers, JACK is the one coming. Coverage is Cover 3, quarters, or man — you name the shell on that snap, because he mixes them.

The first series is the defense working. FAU has it. Third-and-10 at the Florida 35. Coleman is already in the window because the front made the quarterback hold it. That is not heat getting lucky. That is the picture paying.

The areas of opportunity were not a pile of missed tackles. The secondary was not on the same call. And the Sledge keep — the design was sound. They lost the play. Right call. Unfinished job.

specials.body: Florida never punts. That is not a slogan. They took the points with Patrick Durkin from 53, and when FAU’s punt died at 18 yards the next Florida score was already teed up.
